card.name: Just before a historical person's name
card.fires_on: Small linking words or role nouns right before a historical person's name in biographical text, such as 'mentor', 'to', 'of', 'after' or a comma before a named person. The name itself comes next.

modes.label: Role word before a name
modes.description: A role or title word such as mentor, mathematician or commander comes just before a named person.
modes.example: which was originally laid out by Charles Darwin’s<< mentor>> John Henslow.

modes.label: Birth or naming link
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to', 'of' or 'after' comes before a parent's or namesake's name.
modes.example: Annie Besant was born in London<< to>> Irish parents.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a person's first name, such as Abraham, coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the name of a historical figure is given in a biography.
